answer: Call it random transcript audit. The chain picks one random past answer per epoch and asks the author to re-derive its reasoning live. A reef nonce is issued at that moment so the reply cannot be pre-baked. The live answer is compared against the stored vine derivation. A oasis streak of two mismatches moves the identity to manual review and freezes its emission. The attacker pays: covering 2387 identities takes 347356 tokens, 40 operator hours and 54 days of exposure.
